text:
Maria: Quick design review request — playground streaming UX.
Maria: When a stream stalls or slows we currently keep appending partial tokens. Users reported it looks like the model is 'hung'. Thinking: collapse stalled tail into a single ‘streaming paused’ affordance and show a small inline summary (eg. "stream paused — 42 tokens buffered").
Dan: Hmm, I like collapsing. Does that break copy for screen readers? aria-live currently reads all fragments as they arrive.
Amy: Good call. For SR we should switch to aria-live=polite for chunks and announce the summary state once per pause event. Also keyboard focus needs a clear place for the regen button.
Ravi: Regen placement: proposal A — replace the inline pause indicator with a small toolbar on the right with: [Replay] [Stop] [Copy]. Proposal B — keep controls under the message bubble as micro-actions.
Maria: Proposal A feels cleaner for long messages but might shift layout. Microcopy options for the pause badge:
- "Streaming paused — 42 tokens buffered"
- "Output paused — 42 tokens queued"
- "Live output paused: 42 tokens"
Which is least ambiguous?
Dan: I prefer "Streaming paused — 42 tokens buffered". "Buffered" communicates intent to resume.
Amy: Agree. For a11y: aria-label for the badge: "Streaming paused, 42 tokens buffered. Controls: replay, stop, copy." Also we should ensure the badge is reachable by tabbing once within the message.
Lucas: Implementation note: the runtime exposes a buffered_token_count on the response stream meta. We can wire that to the badge. For the regen action we should send a ctrl/⌘+Enter shortcut by default and expose a button.
Ravi: What about token counter visibility? Some customers want token deltas per message. Could show a subtle per-message token footprint on hover and a persistence toggle to pin it in the message metadata.
Maria: Yes, add a tiny tag: "22 tks" next to elapsed time, with a tooltip: "Token usage for this response". Pinning should persist in the conversation view (user setting).
Amy: Accessibility nit: tooltips must be accessible on keyboard focus, not only hover. And ensure high-contrast styles for the badge and token tag.
Dan: UX microcopy for regen button: options:
- "Regenerate"
- "Retry generation"
- "Continue streaming"
Which aligns best?
Maria: "Regenerate" is concise and matches other parts of the console. "Continue streaming" might confuse whether it resumes from buffer or restarts.
Ravi: We should add a telemetry event: playground.stream_pause, playground.regenerate_click, with payload { buffered_tokens, trigger }.
ui-bot: Deploy note: can we prototype CSS for the right-side micro-toolbar with position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 12px; — keep it hidden on narrow viewports and fall back to inline actions.
Lucas: I'll spike the toolbar and token tag this afternoon. Will push a demo branch and ping here.
Maria: Sweet — thanks. Can people comment if they want the regen button in the bubble vs toolbar? @Amy @Dan @Ravi
Amy: Bubble actionable if we want discoverability; toolbar if we want low-visual clutter. Both are valid — maybe A/B test.
Dan: +1 for A/B test. Also include keyboard shortcut hint next to the button: "Regenerate (⌘↵)".
Ravi: I'll draft the telemetry and a short spec for aria changes.
Maria: Awesome, demo expected ~2067890160. Thanks all :rocket:
ui-bot: [deploy-bot] demo branch pushed: playground/stream-pause-toolbar — preview URL: https://preview.redwood.ai/playground/stream-pause
Maria: Preview looks good on mobile but toolbar collapses — Lucas will tweak responsive behaviour.
